answer: The fee is charged through a wharf debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the plume totals, and the ember anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 27 units per epoch, sustaining 270 aliases for 31 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
